name: Unsure which labour law applies
expected: Explains applicability of UP Shops & Commercial Establishments Act and Contract Act 1872 for IT professionals.
prompt: I work in an IT company in Noida. Do labour laws apply to software engineers?
raw_response:
Hello, I am LawPilot AI, your Indian legal assistant, here to help you understand your employment rights regarding your query.

### | Your Situation
You are a software engineer working at an IT company in Noida, Uttar Pradesh, and you want to know whether labor laws protect your employment rights. The key issue is determining the legal applicability of Indian labor and state-specific commercial legislations to IT and software professionals.

### | Your Legal Position
* **State Shops and Commercial Establishments Act:** IT companies and private offices in Noida operate as commercial establishments under the Uttar Pradesh Shops and Commercial Establishments Act, 1962, which governs service conditions, working hours, leave

citations.act_name: State Shops and Commercial Establishments Acts
citations.section: Settlement of Dues and Service Conditions Provision
citations.title: Statutory Payment of Earned Salary and Notice Pay for Private/Commercial Employees
citations.description: State-specific legislation (e.g., Delhi Shops Act, Karnataka Shops & Commercial Establishments Act, Maharashtra Shops Act) governing commercial and IT/office establishments. Mandates clearance of earned wages and final settlement upon termination or resignation within 3 to 15 days.

citations.title: Recovery of money due from an employer
citations.description: Where any workman is entitled to receive from the employer any money or any benefit which is capable of being computed in terms of money, the workman may apply to the Labour Court for recovery.

citations.title: Time of payment of wages and Claims arising out of deductions from wages or delay in payment
citations.description: Wages must be paid before the expiry of the 7th day after the wage period (or 10th day if more than 1,000 persons employed). Section 15 provides for application to the designated Authority for delayed wages with compensation up to ten times the amount deducted/delayed.

citations.title: Deductions which may be made from wages
citations.description: Strictly enumerates permissible deductions (such as authorized provident fund, income tax, or willful damage shown after formal inquiry). Any arbitrary or unauthorized deduction is unlawful.
